package teacherdialog

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
)

type Clock interface {
	Now() time.Time
}

// Intake takes durable ownership before the NATS trigger is acknowledged.
type Intake struct {
	Jobs  repository.TeacherDialogJob
	Clock Clock
}

func (useCase Intake) Handle(ctx context.Context, request domain.DialogTeacherRequest) (bool, error) {
	if useCase.Jobs == nil || useCase.Clock == nil {
		return false, errors.New("teacher dialog intake dependencies are required")
	}
	job, err := domain.NewTeacherDialogJob(request, useCase.Clock.Now())
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	return useCase.Jobs.Accept(ctx, job)
}
